Emergency Lighting Basics

What emergency lighting does

Emergency lighting activates automatically when mains power is lost, maintaining visibility along escape routes so occupants can move safely toward an exit.

Maintained vs non-maintained

Maintained fittings stay illuminated continuously, while non-maintained fittings activate only when mains power fails. The right choice depends on the space and how it's normally used.

Coverage along the escape route

Consistent lighting coverage — rather than isolated fittings — helps ensure there are no dark gaps along a corridor or stairwell during an evacuation.

Exit signage

Illuminated or photoluminescent exit signs work alongside emergency lighting to clearly mark the direction of travel toward the nearest safe exit.
